thread:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Landfall POC kickoff. Customer requirement: EU + Canada data residency for inference and logs. They prefer hosted API but want requests pinned to region. Any immediate blockers on routing/subproc/KMS?

ashley_engineer: We can do tenant-region pinning for inference path (model servers in eu/ca). Control plane still global unless Private. Important: prefix/KV cache lives in the region we serve, but control plane metadata may cross regions.

kevin_privsec: Legal will push back if control plane metadata crosses borders. They want subprocessors list & BYO-KMS options. Also need confirmation on egress paths for failover (no cross-border allowed).

sam_ops: Quick ops notes — current default failover is region -> nearest region -> global. We can change to "fail-closed" (no fallback) but that raises availability risk. Need to confirm SLO tolerance.

maria_sales: Customer insists on no cross-border even for failover. They asked about SLA credits for availability if we do no-fallback. Can we price that?

ashley_engineer: Pricing-wise: making a hard region-isolated routing increases unit cost due to lower packing + dedicated regional pools. Rough delta: hosted +12–20% unit cost. Dedicated/reserved capacity reduces delta but adds monthly commit. If they require control-plane in-region or Private, timeline and cost jump (Private control plane: 6–8 weeks + infra fee).

kevin_privsec: Security checklist they want now: full subprocessor list for eu/ca, BYO-KMS support & key residency, audit-log retention location, and DPA language for no cross-border egress. Can engineering confirm BYO-KMS feasibility for hosted?

ashley_engineer: BYO-KMS for hosted is supported for customer-managed keys in certain regions (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure KeyVault). Caveat: control plane must be able to call an encrypt/decrypt endpoint — if control plane is global, key policy needs to allow it or we need a separate key proxy in-region (adds complexity).

maria_sales: Would a config example help for presales?

ashley_engineer: Example routing snippet we can share:

```
routing_policy:
  mode: tenant_pin
  preferred_regions: ["eu-west-1", "ca-central-1"]
  failover: "no-fallback"   # options: best-effort / no-fallback
  kms:
    byo: true
    allowed_providers: ["aws-kms", "gcp-kms"]
```

Note: enabling no-fallback requires acceptance of potential availability outages if regional capacity drops.

sam_ops: Operational checklist to enable hosted EU+CA pinning:
- Confirm subnet + VPC peering for CA/EU model pools
- Whitelist customer IPs for management APIs (if requested)
- Rotation plan for regional certs 
- Create INF ticket to provision regional pools (ETA ~3 weeks for standard priority)

ops-bot: INF-2345 created: "Landfall POC - provision eu/ca tenant pin pools"

kevin_privsec: Also: will need subprocessors attestation. Quick list (draft): AWS eu-west-1, GCP europe-west2, Azure canada-central, Datadog EU, Sumo/Logpipe (EU cluster). I'll have legal prepare a DPA addendum.

maria_sales: Great. For pricing: I'll propose hosted with region pin + 18% uplift, or Dedicated monthly commit option (we'll get numbers from finance). Can someone confirm ETA for the hosted enable?

sam_ops: ETA: 3 weeks to enable routing + provision pools, 1 week for KMS policy work if keys already exist. Add 2 weeks if we need custom key proxy.

ashley_engineer: One more: some open models are only available in certain regions due to licensing; if Landfall needs a specific model, we must verify model availability in eu/ca or plan a compatible variant. I'll run a model-region matrix and post.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll update the SOW draft with these options and flag the DPA/No-cross-border term. cc @kevin_privsec for legal thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
